1.0 Executive Summary.Summary: The project involves migrating a legacy Teradata environment and its associated workloads to a modern, robust, and scalable data warehouse on the Google Cloud Platform. The objective is to maintain the same data model and business logic while leveraging automation tools and expert professional services.
Major_Tracks: Track 1: Teradata Migration to Google Cloud Platform

1.1 Opportunity.Details: The primary business drivers for this migration include: (a) Reduction of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) by decommissioning legacy on-premise hardware; (b) Resolution of critical performance bottlenecks in executive reporting; (c) Enabling elastic scalability for peak workloads; and (d) Unlocking advanced AI/ML capabilities within the BigQuery ecosystem.

1.2 Solution Overview:.Proposed_Solution: The contractor will provide professional services using migration capabilities, automation tools, and subject matter experts.

Architecture_Components.Source_Systems: ERP, ODS, Workday, and file-based systems.
Architecture_Components.Accelerators: Lineage Explorer UI for assessment and Pelican for data validation.

2.0 Scope.Project_Scope: The engagement includes two primary tracks: Track 1 for Teradata to GCP migration and Track 2 for the refresh of on-premise assessment outputs and lineage explorer provisioning.

In-Scope_Inventory.Data_Validation_Strategy: Deployment of 'Pelican' for automated row-count, checksum, and 5% random sample validation across all migrated tables.

Discovery_Analysis_and_Design: Migration planning and documentation (Milestone and Approach)
Migration inventory (database objects, code, use cases)
Communication plan including Project governance and cadence
Historical_Data_Migration: One Time execution of Historical Migration Scripts to load data into Production BigQuery Tables followed by Data Validation
Code_Conversion: Legacy Environment Tables/Views DDLs converted to GCP BigQuery
Legacy and Informatica processing jobs converted to GCP native
Testing: Validation tool reports for Data Validation
Operational_Runbook: Documentation and appendix with machine-readable structured file (e.g., CSV)
Readme files per standard requirements (XXXXX +/- XXXXX% per workflow) at a pipeline level
Critical_Migration_Safety: Rollback Plan: Documented procedure for redirecting application traffic back to Teradata in the event of a Critical P1 issue during the 48-hour cutover window.
Performance Benchmarking: A side-by-side execution report for top 50 complex queries comparing Teradata runtimes vs. BigQuery runtimes.
Go-Live Checklist: Granular hour-by-hour task list for the cutover window with assigned owners and decision points.

Exclusions: Encryption or Decryption of any data
Defect fixing of legacy environment codes
Assessment of BigQuery or other GCP services under this specific SOW
Data Cleansing: Any remediation of existing data quality issues in the source Teradata system is explicitly excluded.
Operations: Post-cutover managed services or hypercare beyond the defined [X] week inspection period.
